title: Suppress completed items from subsequent routine progress reports
abstract: After the 100 percent completion of a project, phase, milestone, task or feature has been reported once, omit it from later routine progress reports while preserving the underlying roadmap and completion history.

source.reference: Generalized project-management and strict-porting proposal; private drafting text not retained

scope_hints.trigger: subsequent reporting after an item's completion was announced

unresolved: Determine behavior for reopened items without silently resetting completion history.
remarks: Proposed atomic rule only. Group membership is non-normative; no processing, task creation, rule publication or application is authorized by intake.
